events.title: 2,000 Wishlists. THANK YOU!
events.summary: We're very proud to share that our game has officially gained 2,400 wishlists.Thank you for your amazing support! For a small indie team, this pushes us to perfect ourselves and bring the demo as soon as possible.Development is going strong! Showcases across the nation gave us valuable feedback and amazing response! We are currently finishing the First Person camera mechanics, adding more customization items and new locations. New gameplay trailer and demo out soon.Thank you!
